title: MERGERS: Multi-Access Edge Resource Governance for Real-Time SaaS Systems
problem: The Multi-access Edge computation (MEC) paradigm is being regarded as a viable alternative for handling data and computation requirements of complex real-time and safety-critical applications in upcoming IoT systems
method: A central control system called the Resource Arbiter receives service requests that need fast responses and decides which edge server should handle each one. Since the servers are different types with different capabilities, the system continuously adapts these routing decisions based on real-time conditions to efficiently distribute work across the servers stationed at 5G network nodes.
key_novelty: The innovation is a centralized control system (Resource Arbiter) that adjusts request routing in real-time based on changing conditions across servers of different types.
